questions.text: Out of his monthly income, Mr. Sharma spends 24% on house rent and 70% on household expenses and saves the balance. If every month, he saves ₹1,200, then what is his monthly income?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 5% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
C.P. of 21 books is equal to S.P. of 20 books. What is the gain percentage?
I walk at a speed of 10 km/h and reach my destination in 2 hrs. If I increase my speed by 2 km/h, how early would I reach my destination?

In a class of 40 students the ratio of boys to girls is 3 : 5. If the average marks scored by the boys in Science is 70 and the average marks scored by the whole class in Science is 60, then find the average marks scored by the girls in Science.
The sum of the radii of spheres A and B is 14 cm, the radius of A being larger than that of B. The difference between their surface areas is 112 π cm2 . What is the ratio of the volumes of B to A?

Rahul and Rohit start running on a circular track (of length 360 m) from the same point simultaneously with a speed of 3 m/s and 4 m/s. After how much time from the start, they will meet again at the starting point?
Manoj buys 1 kg tomato for ₹80 and sells it for ₹90. He also uses a weight of 800 gm in place of 1 kg. What is Manoj’s actual profit percentage on the sale of 1 kg tomato?
The average marks obtained by 75 students in a certain examination is 38. Find the total marks.

In a stationary shop, a pen is marked as ₹80 and it is sold at a discount of 15%. The shopkeeper also offers a special discount of ₹8 on the pen. Find the cost price of the pen if the shopkeeper earns a profit of 20%.
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
Refer the following data table and answer the question. What was the increase in the height (in cm) of the child from the 7th birthday to the 8th birthday?
In an examination, the average marks obtained by 15 students was 96, by 12 other students was 84 and by 13 other students was 68. Find the average marks of all 40 students.
If the height of a triangle is 45 cm and base is 70 cm, then the area of the triangle is:
The speeds of three trains are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 7. What is the ratio of the time taken by them to travel the same distance?
₹7,000 becomes₹7,567 in 2 years at simple interest at a certain rate percentage. Find the principal amount (in₹) that will become₹24,050 in 5 years at the same rate of interest.

The demand and production for five businesses, V, W, X, Y, and Z, are shown in the accompanying chart, which illustrates them using a basic bar graph to provide an answer. If the demand of company Z is k times than that of company W, then find the value of k.
